title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.18076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale image generation has benefited from advances in data scale, quality, rebalancing, and recaptioning, yet conventional pipelines typically optimize task-specific datasets in isolation. A central challenge is not only how to curate each task-specific corpus, but also how to organize heterogeneous supervision according to the dependencies among generative capabilities. We present a \textbf{capability-driven data infrastructure} that couples capability-specific supervision construction with capability-aligned curriculum scheduling. Its three specialized yet interoperable data engines build complementary relational supervision for text-image grounding, inter-image transformation, and image-knowledge association, while caption experts align T2I and editing supervision across tasks and granularities. translated_title: 从语料库到协同演进能力：面向通用图像生成的能力中心数据设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18076v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大规模图像生成受益于数据规模、质量、重平衡和重新标注方面的进展，但传统流水线通常孤立地优化特定任务的数据集。一个核心挑战不仅是如何策划每个特定任务的语料库，而且是如何根据生成能力之间的依赖关系组织异构监督。我们提出了一种**能力驱动的数据基础设施**，它将特定能力的监督构建与能力对齐的课程调度相结合。其三个专门但互操作的数据引擎为文本-图像基础、图像间转换和图像-知识关联构建互补的关系监督，而标题专家在任务和粒度之间对齐T2I和编辑监督。一个多阶段课程沿任务组成、视觉概念分布、数据质量和图像分辨率共同演进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种能力驱动的数据基础设施，通过三个专门数据引擎和课程调度，将异构监督按生成能力依赖关系组织，实现通用图像生成的协同演进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a capability-driven data infrastructure that organizes heterogeneous supervision based on generative capability dependencies, using three specialized data engines and curriculum scheduling to enable co-evolving generalist image generation.
